rows.title: Blu-ray Review: Scott Derrickson’s Sinister on Lionsgate Home Entertainment
rows.comment: Scott Derrickson’s Sinister is one of the most compelling horror films of the past decade.
rows.verdict_le10: Scott Derrickson’s Sinister is one of the most compelling horror films of the past decade.
rows.dek_lead: Personal, understated, and surprisingly strange, Scott Derrickson’s Sinister is one of the most compelling horror films of the past decade.
